events.what: Mozhui and Krishna prove every bipartite graph with smaller part size m is (1+⌈m/2⌉)-representable, and ⌈m/2⌉-representable when m is odd, confirming crown-graph maximality except when both partite sets are equal and even

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. The equal-even case stays open, so this is a case, not whole. The researcher read only the abstract and an HTML summary, not the full paper, so an acknowledgement of AI tools can't be completely ruled out.
